hooks.name: Run Tests After Task Completion
hooks.description: Prompts the agent to run relevant tests after a spec task completes, using the background process workaround.

action.prompt:
A spec task just completed. If the task involved code changes to backend, frontend, or mcp-server, run the relevant test suite using background processes. Use this pattern:

For backend: control_pwsh_process start with command "python -m pytest backend/tests -q --tb=short 2>&1"
For frontend: control_pwsh_process start with command: cmd /c "cd /d c:\Users\ethar\.cursor\projects\MerlinsCollection-Secondary\frontend & npx vitest run --reporter=verbose" 2>&1
For mcp-server: control_pwsh_process start with command: cmd /c "cd /d c:\Users\ethar\.cursor\projects\MerlinsCollection-Secondary\mcp-server & npx vitest run --reporter=verbose" 2>&1

Then poll with get_process_output after waiting (30s for backend, 15s for frontend/mcp). Report results to the user.
